title: Citation
description: Stable mapping from one claim/span in an answer to the specific evidence fragment(s) that support it. Grounding must reject any Citation whose fragment_id is not present in the same request's EvidenceBundle.evidence (Section 10.2) — the fragment_id below is always checked against that list, never trusted on its own.

claim_text.description: The specific span of the answer text this citation supports, verbatim as it appears in GroundedAnswer.answer_text.

fragment_id.description: ID of the ProcedureFragment / Evidence this claim is grounded in. Must match a fragment_id present in the same request's EvidenceBundle.evidence.

source_id.description: ID of the SourceManifest, copied from the matching Evidence for convenience.

source_locator.description: Pointer into the original source document, copied from the matching Evidence, so the citation is independently auditable.
